# ARLing Proof

Free, capacity-limited pilot for small print and sign shops. Create a workspace at https://arling.sk/proof/app/. PNG/JPEG previews up to 5 MiB, versioned production specifications, private customer review links, comments and explicit decisions. JSON and printable record export. Owner UI EN/SK; customer review EN/SK/CS/DE. No active published price. No automatic email or deletion. No prepress, colour accuracy or independent identity verification.

- English: https://arling.sk/proof/
- Slovak: https://arling.sk/proof/sk/
- German: https://arling.sk/proof/de/
- Privacy and scope: https://arling.sk/proof/#privacy
